pillar-church-stafford.assessment: Pillar Church of Stafford is part of the Praetorian Project — a NAMB-funded military-community church-planting network with direct leadership ties to McLean Bible Church's post-2016 church-planting infrastructure. Founding Pillar pastor Clint Clifton is the senior director of resource and research strategy at NAMB AND a Praetorian Project board member; Dale Sutherland (formerly McLean Bible) is listed as president of MBC's church-planting network. Strategically located near Quantico Marine Corps Base. PRIOR ASSESSMENT INCORRECTLY CHARACTERIZED THIS AS A STAFFORD BAPTIST PLANT — that was wrong; it is a Praetorian / NAMB / McLean-Bible-network plant. MOOP (Adam Johns) attended an event here and notes the McLean-Bible-network ties as a meaningful concern: McLean Bible has had significant post-2017 leadership controversy, multiple lawsuits, and post-2020 cultural turn. Adam's broader critique: "some church plants are just attempts to make a church look good on paper — they can't grow a church so they spread out." Pillar may be doing genuine military-community ministry, but the network parentage warrants visit-level discernment.

Green-rated orthodox Reformed option for the Asheville/Hendersonville area.
